slides.title: Smart Textile Safety
slides.subtitle: Controls from design through end of life

body.title: Materials
body.text: Verify skin compatibility, wash durability, and abrasion resistance.

body.title: Power
body.text: Limit current and temperature; isolate batteries and conductors.

body.title: Data
body.text: Use secure pairing, encryption, and minimal telemetry collection.

body.title: Lifecycle
body.text: Provide cleaning, repair, traceability, and disposal instructions.
